segments.en: The words: «The body, the body, microcosm, ease,» and «comfort» are «mnemonics» for matters that the Gemara will discuss, each of which represents a list with shared qualities, similar to the lists cited above.

moves.summary: The redactor supplies a mnemonic for the five lists of three that follow
moves.about: a five-word memory sign (body, body, microcosm, ease, comfort) fixing the order of the lists of three that the Gemara is about to bring
